description: Lock Picking Village focuses on mechanical lock analysis, non-destructive entry, key duplication, safe manipulation, bypass tools, and physical security assessment.

talks.title: Key Duplication: Not Just for the Movies
talks.teaser: Demonstrates practical key duplication techniques, casting, optical decoding, and physical replication tools.

talks.title: Hybrid PhySec Tools
talks.teaser: Showcases multi-functional physical security tools designed for bypass, lock manipulation, and covert entry.

talks.title: Doors, Cameras, and Mantraps, Oh My!
talks.teaser: Examines building perimeter access controls, mantrap bypasses, sensor blind spots, and optical monitoring vulnerabilities.

talks.title: High Security Wafer Locks: An Oxymoron
talks.teaser: Analyzes the internal mechanical mechanisms of wafer locks and tests whether claims of high security hold up against picking.

talks.title: Law School for Lockpickers
talks.teaser: An attorney and locksport enthusiast breaks down state and federal laws governing lockpick possession and covert entry tools.

talks.title: Bobby Pins: More Effective Than Lockpicks
talks.teaser: Demonstrates improvised lock picking using modified bobby pins and everyday materials to defeat common pin-tumbler locks.

talks.title: Intro to High Security Locks and Lockpicking
talks.teaser: Covers the principles, sidebars, interactive elements, and specialized picks required to defeat high-security lock cylinders.

talks.title: Safecracking for Everyone
talks.teaser: Introduces mechanical safe lock operation, wheel packs, contact points, and manipulation techniques to open safes without damage.

talks.title: Keystone to the Kingdom
talks.teaser: Explores master key system architecture, key bitting matrices, and progression attacks to decode entire facility master keys.

talks.title: How I Defeated the Western Electric 30C
talks.teaser: A case study in defeating the vintage Western Electric 30C vault lock through custom tool fabrication and precision picking.

talks.title: Intro to Lockpicking
talks.teaser: A beginner-friendly introduction to pin-tumbler lock mechanics, shear lines, binding order, and single-pin picking.

talks.title: OSINT of Facilities by Physical Recon
talks.teaser: Explains how to gather intelligence on target facilities using physical reconnaissance, satellite imagery, and architectural permits.

talks.title: Cuff Stuff
talks.teaser: Demonstrates the mechanics of standard ratcheting handcuffs, double-locking systems, and bypass techniques using shims and picks.
